Blind and shade repair in Los Angeles

A blind that won’t tilt or a shade that stops halfway doesn’t always need replacing. Tell us what’s happening, and we’ll help you find out whether a repair makes sense.

Ask about a repair(818) 884-5464

Let’s see what can be fixed.

Sometimes a small part is all that stands between a blind that works and one that doesn’t. John has collected components over the years and can help with selected brands, including some products we didn’t originally supply.

The product’s construction, condition and available parts determine what’s possible. If a repair is unlikely to last or replacement looks like the better use of your budget, we’ll talk that through with you.

Tell us about the problem.

A few details about the product and how it’s behaving help us work out what to look at. You don’t need to know the name of the broken part.

For photos, show the whole blind or shade and the area giving you trouble. A picture of the product label is helpful if you can find it.

For a motorized shade, include the system name if you know it and tell us whether the problem affects one shade or several.

Questions about blind and shade repairs

Ask John: (818) 884-5464
Can you repair blinds you didn’t sell?

Sometimes. We can work on selected outside brands when suitable parts are available. Share photos and a description of the problem so we can see whether it’s something we can help with.

Is a repair always less expensive than replacement?

Not always. Parts, labor and the condition of the treatment all matter. We’ll help you weigh the repair against replacement rather than assume an older blind is worth fixing.

Can you help with a motorized shade that isn’t responding?

Tell us which system you have and what happens when you use the control. Some problems can be addressed with phone guidance; others need inspection or parts. We’ll help you work out the next step.

Tell us what’s happening.

Share a few details using the repair inquiry form, or call us to talk about the problem. From our Woodland Hills showroom, we help customers across Los Angeles and nearby Valley communities with repair inquiries.
